scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @pokemon-campus/web" "npm run dev --workspace @pokemon-campus/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @pokemon-campus/web
scripts.dev:phone: npm run build:packages && npm run dev:phone --workspace @pokemon-campus/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @pokemon-campus/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @pokemon-campus/shared && npm run build --workspace @pokemon-campus/game-engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @pokemon-campus/api && npm run build --workspace @pokemon-campus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @pokemon-campus/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @pokemon-campus/game-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @pokemon-campus/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @pokemon-campus/web
